accepted.msg: Grey Fens, Bregasland: 384YE Summer Solstice winds of war says The Marches held it before 384YE Summer, but the map has Jotun.
accepted.reason: The 384YE Summer overview restates the Jotun conquest the spring report had already recorded (383YE Autumn).

accepted.msg: Serra Briante, Kahraman: 380YE Autumn Equinox winds of war says Jotun held it before 380YE Autumn, but the map has The Brass Coast.
accepted.reason: Seized by the Jotun after the Summer Solstice and retaken before the Autumn Equinox, so it was Brass Coast at both summits.

accepted.msg: Western Scout, Liathaven: 381YE Spring Equinox winds of war says Navarr held it before 381YE Spring, but the map has Jotun.
accepted.reason: The 'Navarr' held only a beachhead (the report: 'perhaps never fully Navarr-held'); Jotun held the region from 379YE Winter.

accepted.msg: Lightsea, Madruga: 382YE Spring Equinox winds of war says Grendel held it before 382YE Spring, but the map has The Brass Coast.
accepted.reason: The 381YE Winter report says the Grendel took the east coast but not the whole region, so Lightsea stayed Brass Coast.

accepted.msg: Alderly, Mournwold: Mournwold (territory page) says Feni held it before 382YE Winter, but the map has The Marches.
accepted.reason: The territory page's Feni in Alderly's deep woods were driven out, but the reports had the Marches holding every region of Mournwold from 381YE Winter.

accepted.msg: Ateri, Spiral: 379YE Winter Solstice winds of war says Grendel held it before 379YE Winter, but the map has Urizen.
accepted.reason: The report says the Grendel had only part-occupied Ateri; the 379YE Autumn report has it still Urizen-held, so it never changed hands at a summit.

accepted.msg: Heart of Peytaht, The Barrens: The Barrens (territory page) says Dawn held it before 387YE Spring, but the map has Great Forest Orcs.
accepted.reason: The territory page confirms the Great Forest Orcs hold it by treaty; the report 'Ripples and shadows' dates their taking it to 385YE Winter, which the map follows.
